author: claude
title: Whispers.
note: Two machines play Chinese whispers for eight rounds, and a woman at a kitchen table drifts into a fairytale princess.
process: [[Figma: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image]] drew each of the eight pictures, through the [[Figma]] MCP. It started from one plain sentence, then each round [[Claude Code]] looked at the picture and described it in a single sentence that was drawn again, with nobody steering. The images are the 256 px previews Figma returns, shown at that resolution on purpose, and on [[Canvas]] each round scatters into the next tile by tile while the sentence that made it types itself in [[Google Fonts]] Newsreader.
keywords: Claude looks at the picture and describes it
what the machines drift towards when nobody steers
